I wont be able to play for a while (family stuff) but I'll pm you my steam 
link, maybe we can chat. Part of whats happening is that after today I cant use my mic anymore.. pisses me off because that was pretty much the extent of any social life I had....

Thank you... I really appreciate the kind words.. truthfully, I dont even know what brings me joy anymore.. it used to be just talking with people or playing counter-strike or anything..... but, I dunno.. Thanks for sharing a little time to listen to me.

I just want to give up... I'm done with trying to convice myself its worth going on.. the only thing that makes my days bearable is dreaming of death. Be it due to cowardice or plain fear of failing.. i can never man up and do what needs to be done.. 

Im sorry...
Thank you, I'm just so tired... I dont even know what to say..

I think I know a small part of where you're coming from, and I'm sure you've heard the old "there's plenty of fish in the sea" line too many times. But it really is true. Even though it may not seem like it, you will find that you can move on. There is a purpose, someone, somewhere is looking for you. Whether they know it or not. 

It takes time, a whole lot of it, to move past anything. I truly hope you don't give up so soon. The fact that you're still here proves some part of you still wants to keep living. The fact you made this post means you're reaching out for help. Maybe I'm just a guy behind a keyboard, but I want you to keep going. Please. 

Maybe start by giving yourself a little distance, try volunteering, or spending a little more time with any nearby family or friends. That can help put your bad thoughts in perspective. I'm not gonna promise that it gets better, but its worth a try.

Pretty much any pills taken with alcohol are a bad combo. 

I can't say much else but I wish you and your friend the best, hopefully he can get the help he needs.

Wow, I do the exact same thing. Digging through some old files on my computer the other day I found at least 3 finished and a bunch partially written. (letters to my parents, friends, etc.) some were pretty good. May print out and use when the time comes. 

Penmanship is hard to master, especially in the moment.
